entries.title: arXiv papers show where each author works
entries.body: When you add an arXiv paper from its web version, the app reads each author's institution from the paper's own title block and shows it when you point at an author's name, and under Authors in the article's Metadata. An institution is kept only if it matches words in that author's own entry on the page, so some authors may still have none. Articles you added before this change are not updated.

entries.title: Quoted passages keep their maths and italics
entries.body: Wherever a panel quotes the article, a formula is drawn as maths and italics stay italic, where before you could see the formula's raw typesetting code and plain text. This covers Skim, Quotes, Ideas, Timeline, Search, Glossary, Debate, the cards that appear over links within the article, and the comment and chat boxes.

entries.title: In Skim, the open stop puts its quote first
entries.body: In Skim, the section heading of the stop you have open is smaller and in a softer grey, the small buttons beside it are plain outlines, and the prompt to go deeper is no longer in italics. The quote is the first line your eye lands on.

entries.title: PDF reading warnings are kept and exported
entries.body: When you add a PDF, the app checks its own reading of the file and notes any passages it doubts. Those notes were being thrown away; they are kept with the article and included when you download an article with Export. They are not shown while you read, and notes from PDFs added before this change cannot be recovered.

entries.title: Debate no longer repeats an interrupted web search
entries.body: If preparing Debate was cut off partway through its search of the web, the app started that search again on its own, sometimes more than once. It stops instead and asks you to press Retry. Debate is behind the Experimental features switch on your profile page.
